artworks.title: Mademoiselle Grogniard, Dame de Saint-Just
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper, laid down on mount
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan and Winifred Phillips in Memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated in a semi-profile position from the waist up. She has a round face with delicate features, soft expression, and lightly closed lips. Her hair is styled voluminously with curls and adorned with flowers. She wears a dress with ruffles around the neckline and cuffs, hinting at a historical style. Her right arm rests on her lap, and a bracelet is seen on her hand. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Architectural Fantasy of a Magnificent Ancient Port
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink on laid paper on old mount
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays an architectural scene with classical structures adorned with columns and ornate decorations. The detailed lines and shadows highlight elements like statues and grand staircases. The horizon is concealed by the grand buildings. The etching technique shows precise line work capturing the grandeur. The color palette is primarily sepia and black. The sky features swirling lines indicating movement, with small figures in the distance adding scale to the scene.

artworks.title: Shepherdess
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a shepherd standing and sheep grazing in the foreground. The landscape in the distance includes hints of dwellings and trees. The horizon divides the land and sky with fine, detailed etching brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily black and white. The sky has cloudy details.

artworks.title: Wooded Pond by the Ancient Sluice of Levaux near Vienne
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping and scratching out on cream paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a boat fishing on a calm body of water. In the background, there is a stone bridge with three arches, leading to a dense forest. The style of the drawing is soft and sketch-like, with a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray.

artworks.title: Conversation on the Beach
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on buff paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The sketch shows three individuals seated at a table. Their bodies are depicted from the side in a mid-distance view. The person on the left appears to be wearing a hat and has facial hair. The individual in the middle is less distinct, with vague outlines suggesting a hat and some facial features. The person on the right is also seen in profile, wearing a hat and red and black clothing, with other facial features being indistinct. They are seated on chairs, facing the table, and a dog is visible near the feet of the person on the left. In the background, there are no discernible details. The watercolor style gives the scene a soft, unfinished look with muted colors on a plain paper background.

artworks.title: Gathering Flowers, Shinnecock, Long Island
artworks.medium: pastel on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This drawing shows a landscape of gently rolling hills covered with multicolored grass. The horizon is near the center, showing a pale blue sky with soft clouds. The tall grass on the hills is in shades of green, tan, pale pink, and pale blue. In the center are two large flower boxes filled with flowers in shades of bright yellow, orange, and white. A girl in a white dress bends down by the flower beds, reaching down to pick some bright yellow flowers. She wears bright red tights and a white hat on top of her shoulder-length brown hair. Behind her, on the right, a child appears to sit in a wheelbarrow or sled with long handles, wearing a puffy blue dress and a red hat. Farther away, another person stands in the grass facing the flowers. This person wears a blue dress and a pale blue hat, and they hold a wheelbarrow. All three people have pale skin and blurred faces. In the distance, beyond the hills, we can see patches of a blue body of water.

artworks.title: Man Pruning a Tree
artworks.medium: charcoal on two sheets of laid paper joined together
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a person climbing a tree. The person is seen from behind, reaching upward along the trunk and branches. The figure is depicted from the head to the upper knees, with one leg slightly bent. The face is not detailed, showing only an outline of the head. The person is wearing a simple outfit. The sketch features additional lines suggesting more branches and the texture of the tree, all drawn in a rough pencil or charcoal style on brown paper.

artworks.title: A Dog
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog lying down. The drawing is executed with a medium that gives a reddish-brown tone. It depicts the dog in a relaxed pose, lying on its side with its back to the viewer, showing its textured fur. The artist focuses on capturing the texture and volume of the fur with loose, flowing lines. The background is plain, emphasizing the details of the fur. Light and shadow are depicted falling across the folds of fur, suggesting a gentle light source.

artworks.title: Boys Wading
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: Two pale-skinned boys with their pants rolled up stand knee-deep in crystal-blue water in this horizontal watercolor on paper. Gray pebbles are scattered across a stretch of peachy-tan sand along the bottom of the sheet. Water ripples gently across a channel to a sailboat docked in front of dark gray warehouses and a brown building lining a pier. The boat is robin’s egg blue with a navy stripe across its center. In the distance to our right, two cranes for loading cargo are silhouetted against the pale blue sky that spans the top fifth of the composition. Near the beach, the two boys plant on their fists on their knees to peer down into the water. One boy stands with his back to us in the center of the composition. The other is to our left. He stoops, facing our right in profile. Both wear brimmed hats, long-sleeved shirts, and the boy on our left wears a vest in tones of peanut brown, cream and bright white, straw yellow, and nickel gray. Strokes of opaque white and sparkling blue sweep across the water so the texture of the paper shows through. The artist signed and dated the watercolor in the lower right: “W HOMER 1873.”

artworks.title: Berry Pickers
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a group of people engaging in an outdoor activity. On the left, woman in a brown dress, a tan smock or apron, and a cream hat with a red ribbon faces the right and holds a silver bucket as she leans against a large gray rock or wall. Another woman stands behind her, looking down at the ground, wearing a white dress and a yellow hat with a light blue ribbon. On the right, other people sit or kneel on the bright green ground, including a woman or girl in a yellow dress, two men or boys in white shirts with vests and suspenders, and two other people on the right who are mostly obscured. These people all look down at the ground, and many of them also have buckets. All of the people with visible faces or hands have pale skin. The ground is filled with tall green grass and flowers in shades of yellow, blue, and white, along with small red berries. Farther away on the right, the land meets a distant body of blue water. In the background on the left are several small gray hut-like structures. The sky above is a pale blue-white color.

artworks.title: In the Garden (Rustic Courtship)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows two people, one standing in a garden and the other looking out a window. In the middle, one person is standing with their back to us, facing a red-and-white brick building and holding a long-handled tool on their shoulders. They wear a straw hat, a red shirt, blue suspenders, and greyish-blue pants. The other person is above them, leaning out of the buildings through a window. This person is wearing a dark striped dress with a white bonnet or hat over their gray hair. Both people have pale skin. The garden has green grass, potted plants, sunflowers, and a black-and-white cat walking across the grass on the left.

artworks.title: Looking Out
artworks.medium: graphite and Chinese white on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a solitary figure leaning against a small rowboat on a pebbly shore. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, separating the water from the sky. Faint outlines of distant land and a sailboat are visible along the horizon. The painting uses delicate brushstrokes in shades of brown, grey, and white to accentuate textures and details in the scene. The overall style evokes simplicity and calmness, with tranquil water stretching into the distance.

artworks.title: Boy on a Raft
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a young person on a small wooden raft in the lower right corner. The viewpoint is at water level, facing the child. Foliage blocks the horizon, and water extends into the distance. The brushstrokes are delicate and watercolor-like. The color palette is muted with shades of green, brown, and light blue. A fish is on the raft, and a faint bird outline is in the trees. The sky has a light blue tint.

artworks.title: Yachting Girl
artworks.medium: black crayon, graphite, and white gouache with brush and black ink on buff laid paper mounted on fabric
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Four Fishwives on the Beach
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: Interieur mit der Uhr (Interior with the Clock)
artworks.medium: watercolor on paper mounted on cardboard
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting contains abstract shapes and lines in various colors forming geometric patterns with rounded edges and overlapping layers. Earthy yellows, muted greens, pale blues, and splashes of purple create an abstract representation resembling mosaic tiles or a patchwork quilt. The painting includes sections of soft colors at the top suggesting the sky. To the right is a vertical rectangular form with three blue squares resembling a building. On the left is a circular shape among the other patches of color that looks like an abstract clock.

artworks.title: Composition with Figures
artworks.medium: pen and ink and watercolor on paper mounted on card stock
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting displays rectangular shapes of varied colors including shades of pink, red, brown, orange, yellow-green, and white. Paint has been applied unevenly in some of the sections, allowing spots of off-white paper to show through. Some of the colors also bleed into each other at the edges of the squares. At the bottom are two drawings resembling the outlines of human figures wearing hats. No faces are visible, suggesting the people are facing away from us. The person on the right appears to be on horseback, and the outline of the horse's head is facing the right. There are more lines drawn in other parts of the painting, but they are faint and make no discernable shapes.

artworks.title: At the Edge of the Forest (Edma and Jeanne)
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: In this painting, a woman and a child are seated on the grass in a woodland setting, facing the left. The woman is shown from the side, her legs stretched out in front of her towards the bottom left corner of the painting. She has pale skin and red hair tied back under a white and black hat with a long while veil behind it. The child, seated beside her, is shown from the front, with pale skin and light-yellow hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed white hat. The child has a round face and bright blue eyes. The woman is dressed in a long, white dress with pale gray stripes, and the child appears to be in a matching white outfit. The background is full of green foliage and gray tree trunks.

artworks.title: The Children
artworks.medium: opaque watercolor with graphite on canvas mounted on board
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon

artworks.title: The Driveway
artworks.medium: black pencil on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The landscape view is sketched in a loose pencil technique. The horizon is low, with trees dominating each side of the composition. The left side shows a cluster of large, leafy trees with a variety of shading techniques. The right displays tall, slender trees blending into the sky. In the distance, outlines of buildings are visible, possibly farmhouses, placed in an open terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, achieved through pencil pressure and texture, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Amor Disarmato (Cupid Disarmed)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bert Freidus Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubs and a reclining figure near a fountain. The image shows cherubs around a fountain engaged in different activities. A reclining figure is depicted next to a draped fabric. The background features lush foliage.

artworks.title: A Fountain with Three Tritons
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on beige laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures arranged around a central structure resembling a fountain. The composition includes several muscular figures with dynamic poses, with one figure playing a trumpet or horn. One figure is extending an arm upwards. The figures are seated on what appears to be a cloud or rock formation. The drawing is rendered in pencil or charcoal with shading to bring out the volume and form of the figures against a lightly toned background. Highlights and shadows give a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over black chalk on laid paper, incised for transfer
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several mythological figures in a forest setting. One figure is seated to the right, receiving an object from a winged child-like figure. The figures are depicted with attention to anatomical detail and are set against a background of trees and a distant landscape. The drawing shows influences of Renaissance techniques.

artworks.title: Grotto in the Bois de Boulogne
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a small waterfall flowing into a pool within a forest. The viewer is at eye level with the pool, with the waterfall as the focal point. The surroundings consist of tall trees, lush foliage, and a canopy above, obscuring the sky. The monochromatic color scheme enhances textures and contrasts. Water reflects the environment, giving depth to the composition. Ivy covers rocks near the waterfall, and a pathway can be seen in the distance, lined with forest. The scene evokes a sense of serenity and timelessness.
